Later this week, briefing for busy families
Please give it some attention
Travelers with companion animals should check in early with Aurelia Skyways so the Companion Animal Travel Desk can confirm comfort, carrier, and routing needs.

Animal travel notice

The desk keeps things simple: the welfare coordinator looks at comfort details, and the passenger coordinator explains the steps that need to be followed. If your pet is nervous, large, young, or recovering from a recent issue, say so right away so the team can review the plan and keep the trip steady.

Please bring clear papers, sensible carrier gear, and any feeding or care notes that matter. Keep the animal calm before arrival, avoid last-minute changes, and be ready to follow directions from staff without delay. If a concern comes up, the team will handle it in a calm stepwise review and move to the next safe option if needed.

Aurelia Skyways does not want guesswork at the counter. Share full details, stay patient, and let the desk sort out the practical parts before travel starts.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
